criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Stolen or Lost
categories.definition: Reporting a card as lost, stolen, or stuck in an ATM, or requesting to block or freeze the card to prevent unauthorized use.

categories.name: Card Ordering and Delivery
categories.definition: Requests to order a new physical or virtual card, inquiries about card delivery status, or questions about card types and eligibility.

categories.name: Card Activation and Settings
categories.definition: Issues or inquiries regarding card activation, PIN management, contactless payments, or linking a card to the account.

categories.name: Card Functionality and Declines
categories.definition: Reports of a card not working, being declined, or general inquiries about card usage and acceptance locations.

categories.name: Card Fees and Limits
categories.definition: Questions or disputes regarding fees charged for card usage, ATM withdrawals, or inquiries about card transaction limits.

categories.name: Unauthorized Transactions
categories.definition: Reporting unrecognized, fraudulent, or duplicate transactions on the account, or disputing charges made by others.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with transfers failing, being declined, or pending for too long, including issues where the recipient has not received the funds.

categories.name: Transfer General Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about how to make transfers, transfer methods, processing times, and transfer fees.

categories.name: Top-up Issues
categories.definition: Reports of failed, pending, or reverted top-ups, or issues with specific top-up methods like Apple Pay or Google Pay.

categories.name: Top-up General Inquiry
categories.definition: General questions about top-up methods, limits, fees, and verification requirements.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal Issues
categories.definition: Problems experienced at ATMs, including cash not being dispensed, incorrect amounts, or cards being trapped.

categories.name: Refund Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries about the status of expected refunds from merchants or reporting missing refunds.

categories.name: Exchange Rates
categories.definition: Questions about current exchange rates, how rates are calculated, or disputes regarding the rate applied to a transaction.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Issues or questions regarding the identity verification process, document requirements, or verification failures.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to change personal details, close or delete an account, or general inquiries about account eligibility and age requirements.
